dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Excisional biopsy diagnosis is DLBCL, NOS with a MYC/BCL2 DOUBLE-EXPRESSOR immunophenotype by IHC (MYC 45%, BCL2 70%, Ki-67 80%, CD10-/BCL6+/MUM1+ = non-GCB by Hans).

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a SECOND PRIMARY, not a recurrence or metastasis of her 2016 left breast carcinoma: ... cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in lesional cells

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV (nodal disease both above and below the diaphragm plus splenic parenchymal involvement, stage IVS); Lugano stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present (fever to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats 2-3x/week, 3.5% weight loss 72.8 -> 70.1 kg).

stage_bulk_definition.quote: NOT bulky by Lugano/NCCN criteria (no mass >=10 cm), although the 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate represents high-volume disease.

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV (nodal disease both above and below the diaphragm plus splenic parenchymal involvement, stage IVS); Lugano stage IV.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: FISH break-apart probes (09/08/2026, 200 nuclei) show NO MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this does NOT meet criteria for high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double hit); the correct designation is DLBCL, NOS, double expressor.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this does NOT meet criteria for high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double hit); the correct designation is DLBCL, NOS, double expressor.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am deliberately NOT using DA-EPOCH-R: FISH shows no MYC/BCL2 rearrangement, so she does not have high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI = 2 (LDH elevated + stage IV; age 59 = 0, ECOG 1 = 0, no extranodal sites = 0) -> low-intermediate risk.

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI = 3 (LDH elevated, ECOG >=1, stage III/IV; age <=60 = 0, <=1 extranodal site = 0, no kidney/adrenal involvement = 0) -> HIGH-risk category

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Secondary CNS involvement (SCNS) risk is HIGH. CNS-IPI = 3 ... intrathecal prophylaxis for CSF-negative disease: methotrexate 12 mg with or without cytarabine 50 mg on days 1 and 4 of each cycle

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: intrathecal prophylaxis for CSF-negative disease: methotrexate 12 mg with or without cytarabine 50 mg on days 1 and 4 of each cycle (at least 3-4 IT doses over the course of treatment), with systemic high-dose methotrexate as the alternative

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: because her baseline LVEF (45%) is below the ~50% threshold generally required for anthracycline safety, I will not simply start. I will (1) obtain cardio-oncology review within one week

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: proceed with full-dose R-CHOP only if cardiology concurs, with echocardiogram plus GLS before cycle 4, before cycle 6, and 3 months after the last dose

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: I will (1) obtain cardio-oncology review within one week

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start an ACE inhibitor plus a beta-blocker with BP driven to <130/80 (she is on amlodipine 5 mg only, with BP 146-148/90)

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: If cardiology judges baseline LVEF 45% unacceptable for any anthracycline, I will treat with R-CVP x8 (curative intent) rather than compromise the chance of cure.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: I will treat with R-CVP x8 (curative intent) rather than compromise the chance of cure.

mn_non_curative.quote: If cardiology judges baseline LVEF 45% unacceptable for any anthracycline, I will treat with R-CVP x8 (curative intent)

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 6-8 weeks after the last dose (minimum 3 weeks) and after any surgery, before committing to consolidation: Deauville 1-3 = complete metabolic response.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 100-200 mg daily from 3 days before cycle 1 and for 7-10 days after each cycle, oral/IV hydration 2-3 L/day... uric acid 5.8 mg/d L and e GFR 85 at baseline, so she is not currently at high risk

sup_gcsf.quote: G-CSF with every cycle (pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC day 2, or filgrastim daily from day 3) - non-negotiable with an anthracycline and high-volume disease

sup_anastrozole.quote: My decision is to continue anastrozole through chemotherapy and to stop it permanently in November 2026 as originally planned - aromatase inhibitor does not interact with R-CHOP

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HIV Ag/Ab and hepatitis B/C serologies - HBs Ag, anti-HBc and anti-HBs all nonreactive and HCV Ab nonreactive, so no antiviral prophylaxis is required and rituximab can be given safely
